title: PP 58/2023: monthly and daily TER for PPh 21
summary: From 1 January 2024, PPh 21 withholding uses the average effective rate (TER). For a permanent employee or pensioner, a period that is not the last period uses monthly TER and the last period stays on Pasal 17. A monthly-paid non-permanent employee stays on monthly TER in every month, including December. Daily TER is for a non-permanent employee who is not paid monthly. This diff does not copy the monthly percentage grid.

legal_basis.title: PP Nomor 58 Tahun 2023
legal_basis.pinpoint: Tarif efektif bulanan kategori A, B, dan C, dan tarif efektif harian

legal_basis.title: PMK Nomor 168 Tahun 2023
legal_basis.pinpoint: Berlaku 1 Januari 2024. TER untuk Januari sampai November; setahun tetap Pasal 17.

verification.notes: Category boundaries and the two daily bands are encoded in the regime. The monthly TER rows stay in the PP annex.

changes.summary: Non-final monthly withholding uses TER kategori A, B, or C chosen from PTKP status, applied to monthly gross income. The percentage for a gross-income row is in the annex, which this pack does not transcribe.

computation.notes: Base for the monthly TER is gross income for the month. For a permanent employee or pensioner the last period is still Pasal 17 on taxable income. A monthly-paid non-permanent employee uses the monthly TER in the last month as well.

migration_impact.summary: Payroll must switch the interim month calculation on 1 January 2024. Run Pasal 17 in the last period for permanent employees and pensioners. Keep monthly TER, including December, for monthly-paid non-permanent employees. Category A/B/C follows PTKP status, not a single national percentage.

after.description: TER bulanan by PTKP category. Grid not transcribed.

changes.summary: Daily TER, for a non-permanent employee who is not paid monthly, is 0% up to Rp450,000 of daily gross income and 0.5% above that up to Rp2,500,000. A monthly-paid non-permanent employee uses monthly TER instead. This diff does not state a rate above Rp2,500,000.

computation.notes: 0.005 is only the upper encoded band (above Rp450,000 up to Rp2,500,000). The lower band is 0.

migration_impact.summary: Day-rate payroll for non-permanent employees who are not paid monthly needs the two published bands. Monthly-paid non-permanent employees stay on monthly TER. Do not extrapolate 0.5% above Rp2,500,000 from this pack.
